nameOfQualification: Senior Technician Electronics Engineering and Embedded Systems
description: The Candidate will be able to do Electronic Hardware Design and Testing, Design and installation of PCB, Testing VLSI systems, Testing Embedded Hardware, Design and develop Electronics circuits, Automation of systems, Implement IoT Systems. Will have Exposure on VLSI design, Communication Protocols, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Embedded system, PLC and IoT. The subjects covered in this Programme are - Digital Communication, Advanced Microcontrollers- PIC and ARM, VLSI Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, IoT, Industrial Management, Data Communication, Programmable Logic Controller and Employability Skills. Hands- on projects emphasise design of Electronics Systems using Various Microcontrollers, communication protocols, Power electronics, Artificial Intelligence, IoT and Employability Skills.
